messages:
Elena M.: Heads-up — we start the tenant_id type migration canary in eu-west-1 at 15:00 UTC. This is the small-traffic canary (5%) that kicks off the online backfill and FK validate. Please ack if you're on-call or watching.
DeployBot: Scheduled: tenant-id-migration-canary | starts 2025-11-03T15:00:10Z | canary-size=5% | runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-id-migration | owner: @Elena M. :rocket: 
Samir: ack. I'll be monitoring latency and the backfill queue depth.
Michael (DB): ack. I'll watch long-running locks and check the replica lag. If any ALTER locks > 45s we should pause.
Priya: i'll be on pager. quick question — are we pinning the app version? which release?
Elena M.: yes — release/tag pinned for canary: v2.13.4-migrate. App deploy bot will pin traffic to the migration flag branch. If canary passes we'll lift pin to 50% then full.
Ravi: added a preflight check to the deploy pipeline: it runs `psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM migration_locks WHERE state='active'"` and fails if > 0. Command in pipeline:```bash
# preflight
export PGHOST=write-db.eqw
psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM migration_locks WHERE state='active'" | awk 'NR>2{print $1}' | grep -q '^0$'
```
DeployBot: Canary step started: tenant-id-migration-canary (canary_id=cb-20251103-01) | begin 15:00:10Z. Notifying channels: #ingest, #eng-releases, #prod-monitoring.
Samir: observed small spike in p50 for gen-worker at +40ms at 15:02. not alarming.
Michael (DB): seeing a single relation lock on tenant_profiles (ACCESS EXCLUSIVE) for 12s — likely short-lived. no blockers.
Priya: backfill queue length: 34 -> 28 in 10m. progress looks healthy.
Elena M.: reminder: rollback criteria in runbook — any of: 1) sustained >200ms p90 increase for 10min, 2) replica lag > 10s, 3) ALTER locks > 60s, 4) migration_locks > 0 after preflight. If triggered, run `./scripts/rollback_canary.sh cb-20251103-01` and notify #incidents.
DeployBot: Alert: replica-lag metric crossed 9s at 15:08:22, currently 9.6s. Canary paused automatically per policy (replica-lag threshold=10s). Pause reason: replica lag approaching threshold.
Samir: pinging infra — are we seeing cross-az network jitter?
Ravi: infra says noisy neighbor on eu-west-1b causing brief IO wait. I've throttled background backups and bumped the canary DB pool to 40 connections to help.
Michael (DB): replicas recovering; lag dropping 9.6 -> 6.8 in 3m. I'm fine with resuming once under 5s for 2 consecutive mins.
Priya: observed a small regression in a structured-eval test (embedding stability set) at 15:12 — failure rate +1.2%. not severe but flagging.
Elena M.: let's hold for another 5m — if no other regressions, we resume and increase to 25% traffic. everyone OK?
Samir: OK from infra side.
Michael (DB): OK. good to proceed if lag <5s and no locks >30s.
Priya: OK. I'll keep the eval watch.
DeployBot: Resume requested by Elena M. — resuming canary at 15:17:45Z. Next step: increase to 25% after health window 10m.
Elena M.: increase complete. tag `v2.13.4-migrate` rolled to 25% canary. release-notes: https://internal.docs/releases/2.13.4-migrate. Please add any postmortem notes to the doc if you saw anomalies.
Samir: p95 still within bounds, no errors.
Michael (DB): no long locks, replica lag steady ~2.1s.
Priya: evals stable after additional 20m. recommending full rollout.
Elena M.: proceeding to full rollout in 10m. Will schedule a final canary report and mark the migration done if no regressions. thx all. :tada:
